title: STATE 243809: Africa Bureau Friday Report 7/28/89, Sent August 1, 1989
doc_notes: This is a Department of State Africa Bureau Friday Report containing one entry regarding the investigation of physical debris in Mali.

encounters.summary: Unidentified metal fragments found near Koro, Mali, were investigated as potential debris from a U.S. rocket launch.
encounters.quote: Unidentified metal fragments found near Koro in south-central Mali may be the remains of a U.S. rocket
